en.headline: Malaysia wins two titles as Hong Kong Open badminton finals conclude
en.dek: Anders Antonsen took the men's singles by walkover, Wang Zhiyi defended the women's singles, and Malaysian pairs claimed both doubles crowns at Kai Tak Arena.
body: The Li-Ning Hong Kong Open 2026, a Super 500 tournament on the HSBC BWF World Tour, concluded its finals on Sunday at the Kai Tak Arena.

Denmark's Anders Antonsen was awarded the men's singles title after Thailand's Kunlavut Vitidsarn withdrew with a back injury. China's Wang Zhiyi defeated Pornpawee Chochuwong to retain the women's singles crown. In the doubles, Malaysia's Man Wei Chong and Tee Kai Wun beat Indonesia's Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin in the men's, while Pearly Tan and Muralitharan Thinaah won the women's title.
China's Feng Yanzhe and Huang Dongping took the mixed doubles. Organisers said the event ran as scheduled following the withdrawal announcement earlier in the day.

zh.headline: 香港羽毛球公開賽決賽完結 馬來西亞奪兩項冠軍
zh.dek: 安德斯·安東森因對手退賽獲男單冠軍，王祉怡衛冕女單，馬來西亞組合奪得男雙及女雙，賽事在啟德體育園舉行。
body: 李寧香港羽毛球公開賽2026決賽周日在啟德體育園結束，這是匯豐世界羽聯巡迴賽超級500賽事。
丹麥的安德斯·安東森因泰國昆拉武特·威提仙因背傷退賽，以不戰而勝方式奪得男單冠軍。中國的王祉怡擊敗泰國蓬帕威·確楚翁，成功衛冕女單。男雙方面，馬來西亞的萬煒聰與謝凱文擊敗印尼組合；女雙則由馬來西亞的陳康樂與蒂娜奪冠。
混雙由中國的馮彥哲與黃東萍勝出。主辦方表示，賽事在早前宣布退賽後按原定安排進行。
